description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
